name: Pointer-conditioned local ToMe full-video efficacy study
question: Does same-frame object-pointer compatibility improve full-video SAM2 memory-token merging beyond native SAM2 and a merge-budget-matched generic ToMe control?

scope.unit: Full autoregressive video propagation from first labeled-frame prompt; sequence is paired statistical unit.
scope.data_status: Exploratory: PolypGen informed prior method development; sequence-level patient independence is unverified.

method.matching: Within each 4x4 spatial window of each selected memory frame, run pinned ToMe bipartite matching on the normalized mean-head post-RoPE K metric concatenated with each source cell's cosine compatibility to that same frame's stored object pointer.
method.aggregation: Pinned ToMe weighted mean for K/V plus log cluster-mass attention bias; pointer K/V tail remains unchanged.
method.generic_control: Same source-frame schedule and exact per-target, per-frame, per-window merge counts as pointer-conditioned treatment; match using spatial K alone.
method.native_control: Frozen unmodified SAM2, replayed from verified full-cohort native outputs for the paired reference; one full-video native replay is performed per sequence as an exactness check.

engineering_gate.independent_replay: attempt02 and attempt03 results are byte-identical

evaluation.primary: For each sequence, average Dice on all post-prompt GT-present frames; then take the equal mean across 21 sequences.
evaluation.statistics: Paired sequence bootstrap 95% CI, two-sided paired Wilcoxon, Holm correction across the two planned contrasts: pointer-conditioned minus native and pointer-conditioned minus generic.
evaluation.continuation_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice vs native; positive mean and positive 95% CI lower bound vs both native and matched generic; at least 14/21 wins vs native; Holm-adjusted p<0.05 for both contrasts; no increase in pooled GT-empty false alarms.
evaluation.stopping_rule: This single frozen cohort run is reported regardless of outcome. If the screen fails, do not tune or rerun this candidate on PolypGen. Any later claim requires a separately frozen untouched dataset.
evaluation.framewise_yolo_reference: Report historical all-frame mean 0.748099 and previously audited matched post-prompt, GT-present equal-sequence mean 0.718842 separately. The detector/checkpoint and prompting pipeline provenance are incomplete; these are not a fully matched inference benchmark.

execution.resume: Allowed only from a matching setup receipt, source hashes, native reference digest, and per-sequence completion receipts.
